profile.name: Yashvi Poojari
profile.tagline: I build reliable applications by turning requirements into practical solutions, with a focus on clean development, testing, troubleshooting, and maintainable software.

profile.bio: Computer Science and Business Systems undergraduate at RAIT with a strong foundation in programming, data structures, databases, software engineering, and cloud fundamentals. I enjoy turning business requirements into practical software solutions and working across the SDLC — from analysis and development to testing, debugging, documentation, and deployment. AWS Cloud Foundations certified, SIH'24 National Finalist, and currently developing SAP S/4HANA Finance knowledge alongside application engineering skills.
